other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident or citizen of Nagaland
Must be enrolled in a post‑matric class (class 11, 12, undergraduate or postgraduate)
Must secure at least 70 % to 80 % marks in the previous year’s exam
Scholarship renewal requires submission of the last year’s mark sheet
Students belonging to the ST category are eligible
benefits_summary: Provides a scholarship amount to eligible Nagaland students in post‑matric courses, payable monthly or yearly.
